$comment: Pinned corresponding source of the copyleft components of the qualor/scanner image (rulings L1 and L2). pnpm deploy:sources downloads and verifies them into .tmp/scanner-sources; deploy/scanner/SOURCES.md is generated from this file and debian-sources.json (pnpm deploy:sources --index). OpenGrep's tests/semgrep-rules submodule is test data and is left out. On a version bump, re-derive every entry of that component: the tag archive, the commits Bun pins, the OpenGrep submodule gitlinks, and what the release binaries link or bundle (see deploy/README.md). For Trivy (Apache-2.0) and Gitleaks (MIT), only the copyleft (MPL-2.0) Go modules their binaries compile in are pinned.

sources.name: GMP (linked into opengrep-core)
sources.licence: LGPL-3.0-or-later OR GPL-2.0-or-later
sources.pinnedAt: OpenGrep v1.30.0 builds opengrep-core in alpine:3.22 with `make install-deps-ALPINE-for-semgrep-core` (gmp-static) and links it -static; Alpine 3.22 ships gmp-static 6.3.0-r3 (aports main/gmp unchanged on 3.22-stable since 2025-02-10), whose APKBUILD builds this upstream tarball (its sha512 matches the APKBUILD)
sources.why: The opengrep-core binary inside the opengrep release statically links GMP: its strings include GMP assertion messages from mu_div_qr.c, mu_divappr_q.c and "GNU MP: Cannot allocate memory", and __gmpn_ symbols.

sources.name: Alpine build recipe of GMP 6.3.0-r3
sources.licence: MIT (Alpine aports)
sources.pinnedAt: the last aports commit touching main/gmp on the 3.22-stable branch
sources.why: How Alpine configured and built the static GMP that opengrep-core links (no patches are applied).

sources.name: GNU Readline (bundled by the opengrep launcher)
sources.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later
sources.pinnedAt: the ELF build ID of the bundled libreadline.so.7 (cd1bc007ec2e558d662585bf8c5bbcd2b9526faa) equals that of /usr/lib64/libreadline.so.7.0 of readline-7.0-10.el8 in quay.io/pypa/manylinux_2_28_x86_64:2026.09.05-1 (AlmaLinux 8.10), where OpenGrep builds its release binary
sources.why: The opengrep release binary is a Nuitka one-file Python program; it unpacks CPython's readline module and the AlmaLinux 8 libreadline.so.7 it links. This is the AlmaLinux source RPM of that library.

sources.why: The opengrep launcher bundles certifi, the one weak-copyleft (MPL-2.0) Python package it contains. This is its source distribution on PyPI.

sources.name: SonarAnalyzer.CSharp (SonarSource/sonar-dotnet)
sources.licence: LGPL-3.0
sources.pinnedAt: tools/analyzers/install-dotnet.sh SONARANALYZER_VERSION; the tag 9.32.0.97167 is commit cc0ba76c09677fe094621d35ab0c408bd1215aaa
sources.why: qualor/scanner-dotnet ships SonarAnalyzer.CSharp 9.32.0.97167's analyzers DLLs from its NuGet package (tools/analyzers/install-dotnet.sh); this is the source tree of its tag, without the top-level its/ (the integration-test harness). Its own ruling test data lives nested under analyzers/its and analyzers/tests, which a top-level exclude cannot reach; the archive keeps them rather than leave part of the shipped analyzers' own source tree out.
